notes.title: Sprite Update
notes.content: Updated bullet and item sprites, some spawn rates have also been adjusted.

notes.title: Sentry Update 2
notes.content: New sentry item and adjusted spawn rates in this update, also reworked the bullet storm and bounce items.

notes.title: Sentry Update
notes.content: New reticle sprite, sentry allies, an auto bullet storm function, and adjusted spawn rates have been added in this latest update.

notes.title: Idle Defense Update
notes.content: An auto-shoot mechanic has been added and two new ally items have been added in as well. One is a new hover ally and the other generates three allies at once. In the coming updates more idle effects will be added in like turret allies and additional voids. Thanks for your support, stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Color Invert Update
notes.content: New shader update, press [1] throughout the game to invert all colors.

Big update, the game is structured to play as a one-stick shooter and defense game now. You can still download the original version on itch but the official game on Steam will not include both versions. All items have been restructured as a result of the idle defense mechanics, and an additional force field object has been added.

Thanks for your support.
